offsetKind: original member FILE byte offsets, hexadecimal, inclusive
scope: Curated claims for selected routines and formerly stale omissions, not an inventory of the whole game or proof of exhaustive equivalence. Tests compare authored translations with statically derived expectations, never original-machine execution.
maintenance: Authored evidence, not build output. No app/recovered/tools consumers or coverage producer found when replacing the old translated/notTranslated buckets; no compatibility reader is needed. Original-derived bytes, listings, text and numerical tables remain ignored, not copied into this file.

statusMeaning.implemented: Only the stated claim is implemented; limits and browser adaptations still apply.
statusMeaning.omitted: Source behavior deliberately not reproduced, with the replacement identified.
statusMeaning.unknown: The cited evidence does not establish the stated property. Not a claim that the whole routine is untranslated.
